members.name: id
members.doc: Stable key, so each step keeps its own motion when the list changes.

members.name: description
members.doc: A short hint under the label.

members.name: error
members.doc: Marks the step as failed: the marker morphs into an alert and this message replaces the description.

types.name: StepperProps
types.doc: A steps indicator for onboarding, checkout, and setup flows. Place it above (horizontal) or beside (vertical) the step content and drive it with `current`; set `current` to `steps.length` once every step is done. Pass `onStepSelect` to let people return to completed steps by click or keyboard. For a multi-step form that owns its own content, use MultiStepForm.

members.name: current
members.doc: Index of the step in progress. `steps.length` marks the whole flow complete.

members.name: onStepSelect
members.doc: Called with the index of a completed step when it is chosen. Without it the stepper is a read-only indicator.

members.name: details
members.doc: `current` shows only the active step's description, for tight spaces. Errors always show.

members.name: compact
members.doc: Markers only; labels stay available to assistive tech. Horizontal steppers switch to this below 30rem on their own and show the current step's label underneath.

members.name: completeLabel
members.doc: Announced, and shown in the compact caption, once every step is complete.
